'''Rally point Nova''' was a rendezvous point used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Zero Hour" /> In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{RebelsDate|321}}</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire]], Imperial [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] located [[Phoenix Squadron]]'s [[Chopper Base|base]] on the [[planet]] [[Atollon]]. As the rebels evacuated, [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] ordered both the [[Massassi Group]] and [[Phoenix Cell]] [[fleet]]s to jump to [[hyperspace]] and regroup at rally point Nova. However, as Thrawn's [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]] arrived over Atollon, two [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruisers]] prevented the rebel [[Starship|ships]] from jumping to hyperspace and reaching the rally point. As the [[Battle of Atollon]] progressed, the [[interdictor]]s were eventually destroyed, and some rebel ships managed to escape to<ref name="Zero Hour" /> the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Rally point Nova was mentioned in the first part of "[[Zero Hour]],"<ref name="Zero Hour" /> the two part finale of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', which premiered on [[March 25]], [[2017]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|174|Star Wars Rebels Season Three Episode Guide|''Star Wars Rebels'' Season Three Episode Guide}}</ref>
